override_reasons.revenue_growth: WAKIX-only run-off case. 2026 at the $1.0–1.04bn guidance; growth slows as Takeda's Orzeyful (approved 5 Aug 2026) enters narcolepsy type 1; generic pitolisant can launch from March 2030 (with pediatric exclusivity) under 6 of 7 ANDA settlements, so revenue falls 45% then 40%, then decays. No value given to pitolisant GR/HD or BP-205.
override_reasons.ebit_margin: Operating leverage on ~$1bn sales to 2029, then cost cuts only partly offset the generic cliff.
override_reasons.terminal_growth: Revenue keeps shrinking after exclusivity is lost.

WAKIX run-off.description: Generics from 2030 take most of the franchise; no pipeline value.

Lifecycle success.description: Pitolisant GR (PDUFA 1 Apr 2027) and HD (patents to 2044) keep much of the franchise after 2030.
